name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
summary: A lateral raise performed seated to remove leg drive and body swing, keeping the focus on the side delts.
setup: Sit on a bench with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Sit tall or lean slightly forward with the core braced.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows.
execution: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until about shoulder height.
Pause at the top and lower slowly.
mistakes: Using momentum by rocking: choose a lighter weight.
Raising too high: stop around shoulder height.
